review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner, self-review of regression design
review.decision: Address the independently reproduced release review findings before closing the candidate
review.notes: Reviewed the exact preceding PR head, the standalone read-only Codex review, and the actual call paths. Synthetic fixtures only. Review findings are independently obtained; this design record is authored here.

cases.description: Moved binding receipt tracks exact verified frontend after provisional observation is gone
cases.setup: Verified synthetic frontend and its private native binding, with no remaining native observation.
cases.action: Move using real heartbeat and inspect the committed native binding.
cases.expected: The same identity is witnessed at its new address. The old record is not fabricated and the old line remains history.

cases.description: A verified move can reuse a destination with exact closed evidence
cases.setup: Synthetic closed receipt for the indexed destination owner and an independently live frontend.
cases.action: Move into the closed address through the real heartbeat.
cases.expected: The closed receipt releases the destination without acquiring live authority. The new owner's verified identity is published.

cases.description: Detached observed publishes retry temporary global lease contention
cases.setup: Real temporary state lease and a Claude resume publication on another address.
cases.action: Start the observed publish under contention, release the lease and inspect retained state.
cases.expected: The observed update waits through the first short contention interval and publishes independently under the same lease.
